description_en: Unlocks an IoT card after rebinding
name: RebindCards

parameters.help_en: The ICCID numbers of IoT SIM cards. You can specify up to 500 cards per request
parameters.help_zh: 物联网SIM卡卡号，每次最大500条
parameters.name: iccids

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotence. Generate a unique value on your client for each request. The value must contain only ASCII characters and be no longer than 64 characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. Each API request has a different RequestId
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a check. Does not delete the batch task. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, the system returns the corresponding error code. If the check passes, the system returns the error code `DryRunOperation`.

false (default): Performs the operation normally. Deletes the batch task after passing the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除批量操作卡任务。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后删除批量操作卡任务
parameters.name: dry_run
